lessonRef.title: Mastery check: a simple no-heat snack

standardsRefs: Manuel Academy Ready for Life elementary sequence — Grade 3
Ready for Life v1 safety, supervision, and no-shame policy reference
Manuel Academy RFL G3 Unit 3 — kitchen helper safety and no-heat preparation
Manuel Academy local Ready for Life composition
objective: I can practice a simple no-heat snack. I will do one step at a time and check one result.
scenario: With a trusted adult present in the kitchen the whole time, the learner picks one no-heat snack from two or three adult-approved options, washes their hands, gathers the exact ingredients along with a butter knife or spoon, assembles the snack step by step on a clean plate, and wipes the counter when finished.
safetyNotes: A trusted adult stays in the kitchen for the entire snack-assembly process, from gathering ingredients to wiping the counter.
The learner uses only a butter knife or spoon; any sharp chef's knife, the stove, the oven, and small appliances stay off-limits and are handled only by the adult if they are needed at all.
The learner washes hands before starting and keeps any unwashed raw ingredient, like an unwashed piece of fruit, away from ingredients that are already ready to eat.

simulationAlternative.description: If independent ingredient access is not available, the adult washes and pre-sets out all ingredients in separate small bowls, and the learner instead plans the snack on paper by drawing or listing the assembly order, then assembles the snack only from the pre-set bowls with the adult handing each bowl over one at a time.

materials: adult-or-local: cold or room-temperature snack ingredients (adult-approved)
learner-local: a butter knife or spoon
learner-local: a clean cloth for wiping the counter

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-model-card. Watch one complete example.

prompts.text: Name the first move in the model and explain why it comes first.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-guided-card. Do the coached move.

prompts.text: Name the move you completed and the success check it meets.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-independent-card. Choose one complete route. Follow its steps.

prompts.text: Which complete route did you use?
Record the completed step numbers and one non-sensitive result statement.

tasks.directions: Open swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-evidence-record. Save one result and one reflection.

prompts.text: Name one specific step where you had to be extra careful and explain what you did to stay safe during that step.

remediation: Compare the missed move with the worked move on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-model-card; name one observable difference and review only the matching instruction step. Complete the affected move on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-guided-card with one coach prompt and receive feedback tied to the success check. Name the observable move that now meets the check and the one move, if any, that still needs correction. Do not use shame, trait, effort, or character judgments. Complete the same move on the fresh parallel condition in swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-retry-pair without the coach prompt. Exit: The supported and parallel moves both meet the named success check: Tool boundary respected: Learner uses only the butter knife or spoon and cold or room-temperature ingredients throughout. | Hygiene and separation: Learner washes hands before starting and keeps unwashed ingredients away from ready-to-eat ones. | Process completion: Snack is fully assembled in a clear order and the counter is wiped afterward. Resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-independent-card. A physical task resumes only with required permission and supervision; otherwise finish the equal-credit fictional route.
extension: Have the learner plan and assemble a second no-heat snack later in the week using a different combination of ingredients, this time writing their own ingredient list and step order before an adult approves it, instead of choosing from a list an adult already wrote.

resources.title: a simple no-heat snack complete application
resources.purpose: Contains the lesson-specific application directions and prompts; it is the delivered card referenced by the learner flow.
content: Application direction: Before assembling, wash your hands, gather only the ingredients and tools your snack needs, and check that no sharp knife, stove, or appliance is part of your plan.
Response 1 (t2-p1): I washed my hands before touching any ingredient.
Response 2 (t2-p2): I used only cold or room-temperature ingredients and did not turn on the stove, oven, or any appliance.
Response 3 (t2-p3): I used only a butter knife or a spoon, not a sharp chef's knife.
Response 4 (t2-p4): I kept any unwashed raw ingredient away from ingredients that were already ready to eat until it was washed.

Equal-access rule: If independent ingredient access is not available, the adult washes and pre-sets out all ingredients in separate small bowls, and the learner instead plans the snack on paper by drawing or listing the assembly order, then assembles the snack only from the pre-set bowls with the adult handing each bowl over one at a time.

Success checks: Tool boundary respected: Learner uses only the butter knife or spoon and cold or room-temperature ingredients throughout. | Hygiene and separation: Learner washes hands before starting and keeps unwashed ingredients away from ready-to-eat ones. | Process completion: Snack is fully assembled in a clear order and the counter is wiped afterward.

resources.title: a simple no-heat snack supported and parallel retry cards
resources.purpose: Delivers a real correction loop rather than a direction to try again without support.
content: Contrast reteach: compare the model check on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-model-card with the missed or unsupported step; name the one observable difference.
Supported card: return to swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-guided-card, complete the affected move with one coach prompt, and receive criterion-specific feedback.
Parallel card: use a fresh fictional a simple no-heat snack condition with one changed constraint; complete the same move without the coach prompt.

Exit check: the corrected move meets this lesson's checks — Tool boundary respected: Learner uses only the butter knife or spoon and cold or room-temperature ingredients throughout. | Hygiene and separation: Learner washes hands before starting and keeps unwashed ingredients away from ready-to-eat ones. | Process completion: Snack is fully assembled in a clear order and the counter is wiped afterward..
Return: resume at the next unfinished step on swk-rfl-g3-u03-l05-independent-card; a physical route resumes only when the authorized adult says it is safe.

safety.stopRule: Stop the physical route when permission, supervision, a safe setting, or an expected material is missing, or when a new hazard appears. Continue only when the authorized adult resolves it; otherwise use the complete fictional route.

safety.noShameRule: Describe only the observable step, condition, evidence, or revision. Never label the learner, household, body, ability, effort, maturity, responsibility, or character.
